hold.chunk_stalled: The milestone chain paused because a spec stalled; it never retries on its own.
hold.chunk_stopped: The milestone chain paused because a spec's run was stopped.
hold.launch_rejected: The milestone chain could not launch the next spec ({{detail}}).
hold.head_missing: The branch the next spec builds on is gone; resume to rebuild from the integration branch.
hold.head_discarded: A delivery a later spec was built on was discarded.
hold.run_lost: The chain lost track of its spec's run; resume to retry it.
hold.checkpoint: Rail {{done}} of {{total}} delivered; launch the next rail when you are ready.
hold.rail_held: Rail {{rail}} is held ({{detail}}); the chain waits for it.
offer.commit: Add milestone {{n}}'s specs to the board
offer.approve: Approve the plan and write the specs
offer.repair: Ask the Builder to fix its blueprint
prompt.surprise: Surprise me — propose sensible defaults for every blueprint dimension, keep m1Specs empty, and let me approve the plan before generating detailed specs.
prompt.approve: Approved — generate the detailed Milestone-1 backlog now.
prompt.milestone_seed: Generate the detailed specs for milestone {{label}} ("{{title}}"). Read the real codebase first, validate the complete batch, then emit ALL detailed milestone specs in one blueprint-draft response/snapshot.
prompt.milestone_seed_planned: Generate the detailed specs for milestone {{label}} ("{{title}}"). Planned spec titles: {{planned}}. Read the real codebase first, validate the complete batch, then emit ALL detailed milestone specs in one blueprint-draft response/snapshot.
prompt.repair: Your last blueprint-draft block could not be used by the app ({{reason}}). Re-emit the COMPLETE snapshot as strictly valid JSON (newlines inside strings escaped as \n, no trailing commas, no nested code fences) — only the block.
summary.sessions_none: No Builder conversation to resume. Start one with specrails_blueprint(start, message).
summary.writing: The Builder is still writing; call specrails_blueprint(get, ref, options.waitMs) to wait for its reply.
summary.commit_started: Creating project "{{name}}"; call specrails_wait(until, refs: ["{{ref}}"]) to follow it.
summary.commit_done: Project created with milestone 1 on its board.
summary.generating: Generating M{{n}}'s specs; call specrails_blueprint(milestone_generate, milestone: {{n}}, options.waitMs) to wait, or milestones to check.
summary.generated: M{{n}} has {{count}} generated specs ({{quality}}). Commit them with milestone_commit, or send a message to change them.
summary.generated_none: The generation reply had no usable blueprint block ({{reason}}).
summary.committed: Added {{count}} M{{n}} specs to the board.
summary.chain_launched: Launched milestone {{n}}: {{launched}} rail(s) now, {{pending}} waiting; call specrails_wait(until, refs: ["{{ref}}"]).
preview.start: Starts a Builder conversation on {{provider}} and sends the first message.
preview.send: Sends a message to the Builder ({{provider}}).
preview.approve: Approves the plan; the Builder writes every M1 spec in several turns.
preview.repair: Asks the Builder to re-emit or finish its blueprint.
preview.commit: Creates project "{{name}}" at {{location}} with {{specs}} M1 specs on {{providers}}.
preview.commit_defaults: Name and location are the blueprint's defaults; pass options.name and options.location to choose them.
preview.commit_github: Also creates a private GitHub repository and pushes to it.
preview.refine: Asks for changes to M{{n}}'s generated specs.
preview.launch: Launches milestone {{n}}: {{count}} specs, one rail at a time, on {{engine}}; {{advance}}.
preview.advance_on: it continues automatically after each integrated rail
preview.advance_off: it stops for your go after each rail
preview.auto_advance: M{{n}} chain continues automatically ({{count}} specs left).
preview.cancel: Cancels M{{n}}'s chain; running rails keep going, nothing else launches. Launching the milestone again starts a new chain.
error.no_blueprint: Project {{project}} has no blueprint (it was not made with the Project Builder).
error.no_milestone: Milestone {{n}} is not in the blueprint ({{count}} milestones).
error.not_planned: Milestone {{n}} is already {{status}}; its specs are on the board.
error.no_generation: No generated specs for milestone {{n}} yet. Run milestone_generate first, or pass options.specs.
error.not_loaded: Project {{project}} is not loaded yet; try again.
error.chain_active: Milestone {{n}} already has an active chain.
error.not_conversation: {{ref}} is not a Builder conversation or project commit.
error.no_snapshot: The Builder has no blueprint to commit yet; keep the conversation going.
error.engine_fields: options needs provider and model (effort optional), or clear: true.
error.no_spec: There is no Milestone-1 spec {{n}}: the blueprint has {{count}}.
